definitions.intervals: Half-open [begin,end) integer frontend ticks; microseconds are elapsed native-run time.
definitions.dq_model: AttAcc RDRES/WRGB occupy issue+[0,nBL_min); ordinary RD/WR include nCL/nCWL. Native channel bursts are checked disjoint.
definitions.longest: Longest single maximal external-DQ-idle interval within the named scope, never a sum of fragments.
definitions.complete_work: Longest complete-work window merges adjacent meaningful phases with zero external issues after incoming DQ tails are trimmed. DQ-free control-only phases may bridge two work phases; leading/trailing controls are excluded. Any phase issuing external transfers breaks the window, including its idle holes. This semantic metric is distinct from the maximal physical DQ-idle interval.
definitions.stages: Independent native cases are never concatenated. Serial-control stage rows keep actual run timestamps and stop at stage boundaries. The separate serial_layer scope covers its one real continuous native run and may cross those boundaries.
definitions.qkt: Envelope from the first qk_* phase through the last qk_* phase, including all score exports and final Q-slot release. DQ-free phase boundaries do not split windows.
definitions.prefix: qkt_before_first_export ends at the first modeled external score DQ burst, not its command issue or semantic phase boundary. It may include pre-burst CL/row-preparation time.
definitions.all_channels: Complement of the union of all 16 channels' busy intervals; all channels are idle simultaneously.
definitions.totals: dq_idle_total_us is secondary accounting only and is never called a continuous window.
definitions.physical_window_files: The gzip CSV retains every physical window. JSON qkt_windows is a preview restricted to case chain, channel 0, for all four variants.
definitions.distribution: p50/p95 are unweighted window-duration percentiles using linear interpolation.
definitions.boundaries: Windows touching scope boundaries are clipped to the scope; their true extent outside that scope is not claimed.
definitions.limitations: External DQ idle is not MAC active time, an electrical waveform, or measured GPU-usable time. Internal memory waits, refresh and CA use may occur inside it.
